text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин comes away from the
Satsuki Sho
victorious. Her fierce
competitive spirit simply
proves to be
too much.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If Бива Хаяхидэ can fill the gaps in her

calculations, she can win. But no matter
what
solution she thinks up,
premonitions of defeat
plague her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ is shaken. Beside her,
Winning
Ticket stays strong and boldly
declares her
intention to win the
Japanese Derby no matter
what.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Can we rebuild Бива Хаяхидэ's winning
equation
in time for the Derby, where
the three of them
will meet once more?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
